parts.label: National tide
why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 1.46 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 20.4 points of that tide, a tailwind for Brendan Boyle.

D.t: Brendan Boyle leads by 59.9 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 211,690 votes; a one point swing is about 1,768 voters changing sides.
